summary: This note covers the second season of the Marvel Netflix series Jessica Jones, which was released on March 8, 2018. Critics gave it mostly positive reviews, praising Ritter's performance and the series' focus on women, but criticized its pacing and the lack of a villain as compelling as Tennant's Kilgrave from season one. The note also records that a third season was ordered on April 12, 2018.
one_line: Overview of the second season of Jessica Jones, its 2018 release, critical reception, and the order of a third season.
